steps.title: Review wasmedge-runtime configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant wasmedge-runtime configuration:
### Project Title

Memory alignment in WASM instructions

### Motivation

WASM memory instructions can compute addresses that violate the alignment expected by pointer-sized data in WASM32.

steps.title: Apply the fix for LFX Workspace: Memory alignment in WASM instructions
steps.description:
This is a follow-up to #5089.

This PR extends the same WASI typed pointer misalignment trap behavior to args/env and clock host functions. Misaligned typed pointers now trap with `ErrCode::UnalignedAtomicAccess` instead of returning `__WASI_ERRNO_ADDRNOTAVAIL`.

Updated checks:
- `args_si
